title: Shopping On Social Media
subtitle: 社交商務；透過社交平台完成購物交易
description: 社交商務；透過社交平台完成購物交易

words.meaning: 社交商務；透過社交平台完成購物交易
words.note: 當 shopping on social media 泛指在社交媒體平台上發現商品、互動並直接完成購買時，可用 social commerce。這是最常見、最正式的產業用語之一。
words.example: Social commerce allows users to discover and buy products without leaving the platform.
words.exampleZh: 社交商務讓使用者毋須離開平台便可發現並購買產品。

exercises.original: Shopping on social media has grown quickly because users can discover products, read comments, and complete purchases without leaving the platform.
exercises.zh: 社交媒體購物迅速增長，因為使用者可在同一平台發現產品、閱讀留言並完成購買。
exercises.upgrade: social commerce · 社交商務；透過社交平台完成購物交易

options.explanation: online shopping = 網上購物。範圍更廣，包括一般電商網站；本句特別強調社交平台內的發現、互動和購買。
social commerce = 社交商務。discover products + comments + complete purchases without leaving the platform 正是社交商務的核心。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。網紅可推動購買，但這是行銷方式，不是購物活動本身。
social selling = 社交銷售。主要從賣方角度利用社交平台建立關係並促成銷售，不等於消費者購物。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。指以推薦連結賺取佣金的推廣模式，不等於整體社交購物。
digital advertising = 數碼廣告。只是宣傳手段，不表示交易在社交平台完成。

exercises.original: The retailer is investing heavily in shopping on social media so customers can browse and buy directly inside its social channels.
exercises.zh: 零售商大力投資社交媒體購物，讓顧客可直接在社交渠道內瀏覽及購買。
exercises.upgrade: social commerce · 社交商務；透過社交平台完成購物交易

options.explanation: e-commerce generally = 一般電子商務。太廣，沒有社交平台內交易的特徵。
social selling = 社交銷售。重點是賣方利用社交關係推動銷售，不是整個購物流程。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。只是一種推廣方式。
online advertising = 網上廣告。不能表達顧客在社交渠道內直接買。
social commerce = 社交商務。browse and buy directly inside social channels 是最直接的定義線索。
content marketing = 內容行銷。著重用內容吸引受眾，不等於購物交易。

exercises.original: Many brands now treat shopping on social media as a major sales channel rather than just a way to advertise products.
exercises.zh: 很多品牌現時把社交媒體購物視為主要銷售渠道，而不只是產品宣傳方式。
exercises.upgrade: social commerce · 社交商務；透過社交平台完成購物交易

options.explanation: social commerce = 社交商務。major sales channel + not just advertising 明確表示社交平台本身成為交易渠道。
social media marketing = 社交媒體行銷。主要是推廣，不一定包含購買。
digital advertising = 數碼廣告。句子正好說不只是 advertising。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。只是其中一種引流模式。
online browsing = 網上瀏覽。沒有購買行為。
influencer outreach = 接觸網紅合作。屬品牌推廣活動，不是購物模式。

words.note: 這是最直接的名詞片語之一，指透過社交媒體尋找、比較或購買商品。語氣比 social commerce 更日常，也更偏消費者行為。
words.example: Social-media shopping is especially popular among younger consumers.
words.exampleZh: 社交媒體購物在年輕消費者中特別流行。

exercises.original: The survey asks how often teenagers engage in shopping on social media each month.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問青少年每月進行社交媒體購物的頻率。
exercises.upgrade: social-media shopping · 社交媒體購物

options.explanation: influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。是品牌推廣策略，不是青少年的購物行為。
social selling = 社交銷售。偏賣方活動。
online advertising = 網上廣告。不是購物頻率。
social-media shopping = 社交媒體購物。survey + how often teenagers engage in... 是自然的消費者行為表達。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。不是一般消費者購物。
content creation = 內容創作。無關。

exercises.original: Her research compares shopping on social media with shopping on traditional retail websites.
exercises.zh: 她的研究比較社交媒體購物和傳統零售網站購物。
exercises.upgrade: social-media shopping · 社交媒體購物

options.explanation: digital advertising = 數碼廣告。不是消費者購物行為。
social commerce industry = 社交商務產業。太偏產業層級，不像和另一種 shopping 行為直接比較。
social-media shopping = 社交媒體購物。和 shopping on retail websites 平行，最自然。
influencer promotion = 網紅推廣。只是促銷來源。
social selling = 社交銷售。賣方角度。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。商業推廣模式，不是購物行為。

exercises.original: Shopping on social media can feel more spontaneous than visiting a retailer's website with a specific product already in mind.
exercises.zh: 社交媒體購物有時比帶着明確目標進入零售網站更即興。
exercises.upgrade: social-media shopping · 社交媒體購物

options.explanation: online retailing = 網上零售。通常從商家角度描述零售活動。
digital promotion = 數碼推廣。不是購物行為。
affiliate sales = 聯盟銷售。只是一種來源模式。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。不是消費者購物活動本身。
social selling = 社交銷售。偏賣方。
social-media shopping = 社交媒體購物。和 visiting a retailer's website 作消費者行為比較最自然。

words.note: 當 shopping on social media 強調購買渠道本身是社交平台，例如 Instagram、TikTok 或其他社交應用，可用 buying through social platforms。這是清楚、自然的解釋性說法。
words.example: Buying through social platforms has become common among mobile shoppers.
words.exampleZh: 透過社交平台購買已在手機購物者中變得普遍。

exercises.original: Shopping on social media is becoming common among customers who prefer to complete purchases inside the apps they already use.
exercises.zh: 愈來愈多顧客喜歡直接在日常使用的社交應用內完成購買。
exercises.upgrade: buying through social platforms · 透過社交平台購買

options.explanation: social selling = 社交銷售。描述賣家利用社交渠道建立客戶關係。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。不是一般顧客的購買渠道。
online advertising = 網上廣告。沒有交易含義。
influencer outreach = 網紅合作接觸。是品牌活動。
buying through social platforms = 透過社交平台購買。inside the apps they already use 明確指出購買渠道。
digital browsing = 數碼瀏覽。只看不買。

exercises.original: The report found that shopping on social media is especially popular when checkout can be completed without opening another website.
exercises.zh: 報告發現，如果不用開另一個網站便能結帳，透過社交平台購買特別受歡迎。
exercises.upgrade: buying through social platforms · 透過社交平台購買

options.explanation: e-commerce generally = 一般電子商務。沒有指出社交平台是交易渠道。
buying through social platforms = 透過社交平台購買。checkout without another website 是決定性線索。
social media advertising = 社交媒體廣告。廣告可引流，但不是購買本身。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。不是結帳行為。
social selling = 社交銷售。偏賣方。
online research = 網上資料搜尋。無關。

exercises.original: For many users, shopping on social media means buying directly through the platforms where they discover new brands.
exercises.zh: 對很多使用者來說，社交媒體購物就是直接透過發現新品牌的社交平台購買。
exercises.upgrade: buying through social platforms · 透過社交平台購買

options.explanation: buying through social platforms = 透過社交平台購買。原句幾乎直接定義這個概念。
social selling = 社交銷售。是賣方利用平台銷售。
digital advertising = 數碼廣告。只負責曝光。
affiliate promotion = 聯盟推廣。不是所有社交購物都經推薦連結。
online browsing = 網上瀏覽。沒有購買。
brand awareness = 品牌認知。只是知道品牌，不是交易。

words.note: 這是較正式、書面的改寫，常見於報告、研究和商業分析。它和 buying through social platforms 意思接近，但 purchasing 語氣較正式。
words.example: Purchasing via social media is increasing among younger adults.
words.exampleZh: 年輕成年人透過社交媒體購買的情況正在增加。

exercises.original: The study examines shopping on social media among consumers aged eighteen to twenty-four.
exercises.zh: 研究探討十八至二十四歲消費者透過社交媒體購買的情況。
exercises.upgrade: purchasing via social media · 透過社交媒體購買

options.explanation: social selling = 社交銷售。從賣家角度出發，不是消費者購買。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。只是推廣方式。
purchasing via social media = 透過社交媒體購買。study examines... among consumers 是很自然的正式研究用法。
influencer advertising = 網紅廣告。不是一般交易行為。
online browsing = 網上瀏覽。沒有購買。
digital branding = 數碼品牌塑造。無關。

exercises.original: Researchers measured how frequently shopping on social media led to unplanned purchases.
exercises.zh: 研究人員量度透過社交媒體購買有多常導致非計劃消費。
exercises.upgrade: purchasing via social media · 透過社交媒體購買

options.explanation: social-media marketing = 社交媒體行銷。是企業推廣行為。
e-commerce logistics = 電商物流。和購物決策不同。
influencer outreach = 接觸網紅合作。不是交易。
social selling = 社交銷售。賣方角度。
affiliate promotion = 聯盟推廣。只是一種推薦模式。
purchasing via social media = 透過社交媒體購買。research + frequency + unplanned purchases 是正式消費研究語境。

exercises.original: The questionnaire asks whether shopping on social media has changed how often respondents buy clothes online.
exercises.zh: 問卷詢問透過社交媒體購買是否改變受訪者網購衣服的頻率。
exercises.upgrade: purchasing via social media · 透過社交媒體購買

options.explanation: content marketing = 內容行銷。不是消費者購買。
social selling = 社交銷售。偏賣方。
online advertising = 網上廣告。不是購物活動。
purchasing via social media = 透過社交媒體購買。questionnaire + respondents buy clothes 是正式研究語體。
brand engagement = 品牌互動。互動不等於交易。
influencer outreach = 網紅合作。無關。

words.meaning: 直接在社交應用程式內購買
words.note: 當 shopping on social media 特別強調使用者毋須跳到外部網站，而是在社交應用程式內完成選購和結帳，可用 buying directly in social apps。
words.example: Buying directly in social apps removes the need to visit a separate store website.
words.exampleZh: 直接在社交應用程式內購買，毋須另行進入商店網站。

exercises.original: Shopping on social media is easiest when users can add an item to the cart and pay without leaving the app.
exercises.zh: 如果使用者毋須離開應用程式便能加入購物車和付款，社交媒體購物最方便。
exercises.upgrade: buying directly in social apps · 直接在社交應用程式內購買

options.explanation: social selling = 社交銷售。偏賣方客戶開發。
buying directly in social apps = 直接在社交應用內購買。cart + pay + without leaving the app 是最直接線索。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。不能表示結帳位置。
affiliate linking = 聯盟連結。通常反而會把使用者帶到其他網站。
online advertising = 網上廣告。不是付款流程。
brand discovery = 發現品牌。只有購物漏斗前段。

exercises.original: The platform introduced shopping on social media with an in-app checkout that stores payment and delivery details.
exercises.zh: 平台推出應用內結帳，儲存付款及送貨資料，讓使用者直接在社交應用內購買。
exercises.upgrade: buying directly in social apps · 直接在社交應用程式內購買

options.explanation: buying directly in social apps = 直接在社交應用內購買。in-app checkout + stored payment details 是最明確的 app-native purchase flow。
social-media advertising = 社交媒體廣告。只涉及曝光。
influencer outreach = 網紅合作。無關。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。通常涉及外部連結和佣金。
online browsing = 網上瀏覽。沒有付款。
social selling = 社交銷售。賣方活動，不是 in-app checkout。

exercises.original: One advantage of shopping on social media is that customers can sometimes complete the whole purchase inside the app.
exercises.zh: 社交媒體購物的一個優點，是顧客有時可在應用程式內完成整個購買流程。
exercises.upgrade: buying directly in social apps · 直接在社交應用程式內購買

options.explanation: e-commerce logistics = 電商物流。指配送、倉儲等後端流程。
social selling = 社交銷售。不是顧客結帳流程。
affiliate promotion = 聯盟推廣。不是應用內購買。
digital advertising = 數碼廣告。只屬宣傳。
buying directly in social apps = 直接在社交應用內購買。complete the whole purchase inside the app 是直接定義。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。不是交易位置。

words.note: 當 shopping on social media 具體指點擊貼文、圖片或影片中的商品標籤，直接查看商品並購買時，可用 shopping through shoppable posts。這是較具體的社交商務形式。
words.example: Shopping through shoppable posts lets users buy items featured in photos and videos.
words.exampleZh: 透過可購買貼文，使用者可直接購買照片和影片中展示的商品。

exercises.original: Shopping on social media often begins when users tap a product tag in a post and open the product page.
exercises.zh: 社交媒體購物常由使用者點擊貼文中的商品標籤開始，再開啟產品頁。
exercises.upgrade: content creation · 透過可購買貼文購物

options.explanation: affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。可能使用可購買連結，但不等於平台商品標籤本身。
online advertising = 網上廣告。貼文可不是廣告，也可能直接購買。
shopping through shoppable posts = 透過可購買貼文購物。tap a product tag in a post 是決定性線索。
social selling = 社交銷售。偏賣方建立關係。
brand awareness = 品牌認知。只是知道品牌。
content creation = 內容創作。不是購物行為。

exercises.original: The fashion brand encourages shopping on social media by tagging every outfit shown in its posts.
exercises.zh: 時裝品牌在每篇貼文為服裝加商品標籤，鼓勵使用者透過可購買貼文購物。
exercises.upgrade: social selling · 透過可購買貼文購物

options.explanation: digital advertising = 數碼廣告。商品標籤可以出現在非廣告內容中。
shopping through shoppable posts = 透過可購買貼文購物。tagging every outfit 是最直接線索。
social selling = 社交銷售。不是商品標籤購買流程。
influencer outreach = 網紅合作。沒有網紅。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。沒有佣金推薦線索。
online browsing = 網上瀏覽。沒有表達點擊標籤後購買。

exercises.original: For some customers, shopping on social media means seeing a product in a photo, tapping its tag, and buying it immediately.
exercises.zh: 對一些顧客來說，社交媒體購物就是在照片看到產品、點商品標籤，再立即購買。
exercises.upgrade: shopping through shoppable posts · 透過可購買貼文購物

options.explanation: social selling = 社交銷售。不是消費者點標籤購買。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。沒有網紅線索。
online advertising = 網上廣告。重點不是廣告曝光。
shopping through shoppable posts = 透過可購買貼文購物。photo + product tag + immediate purchase 完整描述這種形式。
content marketing = 內容行銷。目的可能是吸引受眾，但不必可購買。
affiliate sales = 聯盟銷售。沒有佣金推薦連結。

words.note: 當 shopping on social media 指觀眾一邊看直播介紹或示範產品，一邊透過直播介面下單購買時，可用 livestream shopping。它是 social commerce 的一個具體子類型。
words.example: Livestream shopping combines product demonstrations with real-time purchasing.
words.exampleZh: 直播購物把產品示範和即時購買結合起來。

exercises.original: Shopping on social media has become especially popular during live video sessions where hosts demonstrate products and viewers can buy immediately.
exercises.zh: 在主持人直播示範產品、觀眾可即時購買的情況下，社交媒體購物特別流行。
exercises.upgrade: livestream shopping · 直播購物

options.explanation: livestream shopping = 直播購物。live video + host demonstrates + viewers buy immediately 是完整定義。
social selling = 社交銷售。不是直播即時購買這個特定形式。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。直播可能包含推薦連結，但不是必然。
online advertising = 網上廣告。直播銷售不只展示廣告。
shoppable posts only = 只有可購買貼文。直播不是一般靜態貼文。
brand engagement = 品牌互動。互動不等於購買。

exercises.original: The beauty company uses shopping on social media events in which a host answers questions live while viewers add products to their carts.
exercises.zh: 美容公司舉辦直播購物活動，主持人即時回答問題，觀眾同時把產品加入購物車。
exercises.upgrade: livestream shopping · 直播購物

options.explanation: social-media advertising = 社交媒體廣告。沒有 capture real-time Q&A plus cart purchasing。
affiliate promotion = 聯盟推廣。不是必然有佣金連結。
influencer outreach = 網紅合作。主持人未必是網紅，而且重點是即時購買。
social selling = 社交銷售。範圍較廣。
livestream shopping = 直播購物。host answers live + viewers add products to carts 是典型模式。
online browsing = 網上瀏覽。沒有交易含義。

exercises.original: In some markets, shopping on social media is strongly associated with hosts selling products during live broadcasts.
exercises.zh: 在一些市場，社交媒體購物和主持人在直播期間售賣產品密切相關。
exercises.upgrade: livestream shopping · 直播購物

options.explanation: social commerce broadly = 廣義社交商務。範圍太廣，包含貼文購物等其他形式。
livestream shopping = 直播購物。hosts selling products during live broadcasts 是最直接線索。
digital advertising = 數碼廣告。直播中可以有廣告，但重點是交易。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。不是所有直播購物都屬聯盟模式。
social selling = 社交銷售。較廣、賣方導向。
content marketing = 內容行銷。不是直播即時成交。

words.meaning: 社交式購物；受社群互動影響的購物
words.note: social shopping 可作較廣的近義詞，強調購物過程包含朋友、社群、留言、推薦或互動等社交元素。它有時不一定在平台內直接結帳，因此比 social commerce 更廣。
words.example: Social shopping blends product discovery with recommendations and interaction from other users.
words.exampleZh: 社交式購物把商品發現、他人推薦和社群互動結合起來。

exercises.original: Shopping on social media often feels social because users read comments, ask friends, and share products before deciding what to buy.
exercises.zh: 社交媒體購物常帶強烈社交元素，使用者會看留言、問朋友並分享產品後才決定購買。
exercises.upgrade: social shopping · 社交式購物；受社群互動影響的購物

options.explanation: online retailing = 網上零售。只表示網上買賣，未必有社交互動。
digital advertising = 數碼廣告。不是消費者互動型購物。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。沒有朋友／留言互動這個核心。
social shopping = 社交式購物。comments + friends + sharing products 正是購物中的社交元素。
social selling = 社交銷售。賣方建立關係，不是消費者之間互動。
brand awareness = 品牌認知。無購買決策過程。

exercises.original: The app makes shopping on social media more collaborative by letting friends vote on products in a shared list.
exercises.zh: 這個應用讓朋友可在共用清單為產品投票，使社交媒體購物變得更協作。
exercises.upgrade: social shopping · 社交式購物；受社群互動影響的購物

options.explanation: social commerce only = 只指社交商務。social commerce 可以包含交易，但 friends voting 更強調社交協作。
affiliate marketing = 聯盟行銷。無關。
influencer marketing = 網紅行銷。朋友投票不是網紅推廣。
online advertising = 網上廣告。無關。
social selling = 社交銷售。賣方導向。
social shopping = 社交式購物。friends vote + shared list 是典型共同參與購物。

exercises.original: For these users, shopping on social media is less about instant checkout and more about getting recommendations from their online community.
exercises.zh: 對這些使用者來說，社交媒體購物較少着重即時結帳，反而更重視從網上社群取得推薦。
exercises.upgrade: social shopping · 社交式購物；受社群互動影響的購物

options.explanation: social selling = 社交銷售。仍是賣方角度。
affiliate promotion = 聯盟推廣。不是社群推薦的總稱。
social shopping = 社交式購物。online community recommendations + not necessarily instant checkout 正好符合這個較廣概念。
digital advertising = 數碼廣告。沒有社群互動意味。
e-commerce logistics = 電商物流。完全無關。
influencer outreach = 網紅合作。不是一般社群推薦。

falseSynonyms.zh: 社交銷售不等於 shopping on social media 本身 social selling 主要從賣方角度出發，指透過社交平台建立客戶關係、培養潛在客戶並促成銷售；不等於消費者 shopping on social media。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Social selling is seller-side relationship building; social shopping is buyer-side shopping activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 社交媒體行銷不等於 shopping on social media 本身 它指品牌在社交媒體上的推廣活動，可能帶來銷售，但本身不是購物行為。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Marketing promotes products; shopping involves the consumer's purchase journey.

falseSynonyms.zh: 網紅行銷不等於 shopping on social media 本身 網紅行銷是利用創作者或網紅推薦產品。它可以促成社交購物，但只是其中一種推廣方式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Influencer marketing can drive social commerce, but it is not the same thing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 聯盟行銷不等於 shopping on social media 本身 聯盟行銷透過推薦連結或代碼取得佣金。社交媒體購物不一定涉及聯盟佣金。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Affiliate marketing is a commission-based promotion model.

falseSynonyms.zh: 網上購物不等於 shopping on social media 本身 online shopping 範圍更廣，包括品牌官網、市集平台和一般電商網站；shopping on social media 只是一個子類型。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON All social-media shopping is online shopping, but not all online shopping is social-media shopping.

falseSynonyms.zh: 電子商務不等於 shopping on social media 本身 e-commerce 是更大的商業範疇，涵蓋網站、平台、支付和物流等；social commerce 只是其中一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Social commerce is a form of e-commerce.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可購買內容不等於 shopping on social media 本身 shoppable content 指可點擊商品或直接購買的內容本身，不是消費者的購物活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Shoppable content enables shopping; it is not the act of shopping.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數碼廣告不等於 shopping on social media 本身 數碼廣告只表示透過數碼渠道投放廣告。看到廣告不等於已經進行社交購物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Advertising creates exposure; shopping involves product selection and purchase.
